evals.prompt: I need to register a global hotkey (Cmd+Shift+K) in my Electron app that triggers recording even when the app is in the background. Currently it only works when the app window is focused. How do I fix this?
evals.expected_output: Explanation of why focused-only hotkeys occur, solutions using iohook-macos or globalShortcut with proper setup, permission requirements, and code examples showing the correct implementation

evals.prompt: After recording audio and transcribing it, I need to type the text into whatever app the user has in focus. Using robotjs.typeString() but it seems to drop characters or type slowly. The text should appear instantly in focused app.
evals.expected_output: Recommendations for: optimal delay parameters, character-by-character vs bulk typing, accessibility permissions verification, alternative methods for special characters, and debugging approach

evals.prompt: I want to save the current clipboard content, then put my transcribed text on the clipboard, and restore the previous content after the user pastes. Code for clipboard read/write/restore cycle please.
evals.expected_output: Complete code example using robotjs clipboard APIs showing: read current, save backup, write new content, restore original with proper error handling and timing considerations
